import numpy as np
y=-dP_dt
def gn_fit(X_fun, p0, iters=60):
    p=np.array(p0,float)
    for _ in range(iters):
        f=X_fun(p)
        J=np.zeros((len(y),len(p)))
        for k in range(len(p)):
            dp=np.zeros(len(p)); h=1e-6*max(1,abs(p[k])); dp[k]=h
            J[:,k]=(X_fun(p+dp)-f)/h
        r=y-f
        step=np.linalg.lstsq(J,r,rcond=None)[0]
        p=p+step
    return p, np.mean((y-X_fun(p))**2)/np.var(y)

import numpy as np
y=-dP_dt
def gn(fun,p0,iters=80):
    p=np.array(p0,float); lam=1e-3
    def cost(p):
        with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
            f=fun(p)
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(f)): return np.inf,f
        return np.sum((y-f)**2),f
    c,f=cost(p)
    for _ in range(iters):
        J=np.zeros((len(y),len(p)))
        for k in range(len(p)):
            dp=np.zeros(len(p)); h=1e-7*max(1,abs(p[k])); dp[k]=h
            J[:,k]=(fun(p+dp)-f)/h
        r=y-f
        A=J.T@J; g=J.T@r
        while True:
            step=np.linalg.solve(A+lam*np.diag(np.diag(A)+1e-9),g)
            cn,fn=cost(p+step)
            if cn<c: p=p+step; c,f=cn,fn; lam=max(lam/3,1e-9); break
            lam*=4
            if lam>1e8: break
        if lam>1e8: break
    return p, c/np.sum((y-y.mean())**2)

    return (-(p[0]+p[1]*sP+p[2]*P+p[3]*P**2)*np.abs(t)**p[4]
            -(p[5]+p[6]*P+p[7]*P**2)*np.log(1+t)
            -p[8]*P*t - p[9]*P*np.sqrt(1+t))
